guide.summary: Museums, temples, gardens and Bund landmarks, with breakfast spots, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Plan museum days around split closures: Shanghai Museum's People's Square site shuts on Mondays, while Shanghai Museum East and the Shanghai Natural History Museum shut on Tuesdays, except on national public holidays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Shanghai Museum (People's Square), the Memorial of the First National Congress of the CPC and the Shanghai Jewish Refugees Museum close on Mondays. Shanghai Museum East and the Shanghai Natural History Museum close on Tuesdays except national public holidays.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Shanghai Museum asks you to book and buy tickets before visiting the People's Square site while its Ancient Americas exhibition runs, though basic galleries at Shanghai Museum East need no booking. The Shanghai Natural History Museum sells real-name tickets online and checks ID on site.

toolkit.label: Last entry and walk-ins
toolkit.copy: Entry stops at 15:00 at Shanghai Museum (People's Square), at 16:00 at the Shanghai Natural History Museum and the Shanghai Jewish Refugees Museum, and at 16:30 at the CPC memorial. Mr & Mrs Bund asks you to phone for same-day tables, and Punch Room at The Shanghai EDITION is reservation-only.

toolkit.label: Rules and age
toolkit.value: Casual dress, free for small children
toolkit.copy: The Shanghai EDITION lists a casual dress code for ROOF, Punch Room and Shanghai Tavern. At the Shanghai Natural History Museum, children 1.3 m or under (or aged 6 and under) and visitors aged 70 and over enter free.

guide.dek: Book Shanghai Museum's People's Square site before you go, and plan museum days around the Monday and Tuesday closures.
intro: Shanghai Museum now runs two sites, and their schedules differ. The People's Square building at 201 Renmin Avenue opens from 9:00 to 17:00, stops entry at 15:00 and closes on Mondays except national public holidays. Its Ancient Americas exhibition runs from 9 July 2026 to 14 November 2027, and while it is on you need to book and buy a ticket before you go. Shanghai Museum East, at 1952 Century Avenue in Pudong, opens from 10:00 to 18:00, closes on Tuesdays, needs no booking for its basic galleries and shows treasures from the Silla kingdom until 18 January 2027.

For modern history, the Memorial of the First National Congress of the CPC on Huangpi South Road opens Tuesday to Sunday and runs free Chinese-language guided tours at set times through the day. The Shanghai Jewish Refugees Museum on Changyang Road in Hongkou also opens Tuesday to Sunday, with last entry at 16:00. With children, you can pair the Shanghai Natural History Museum, inside Jing'an Sculpture Park, which sells real-name tickets online, with the Shanghai Botanical Garden on Longwu Road, where the main gate is free and only the specialty gardens charge.

On the Bund, the Fairmont Peace Hotel at 20 Nanjing Road East keeps its Jazz Bar going with nightly sets by the Old Jazz Band. The hotel also offers a free 30-minute guided tour of its Peace Museum and serves afternoon tea and Sunday brunch in the ninth-floor Cathay Room. A short walk away, The Shanghai EDITION has ROOF, a casual 29th-floor rooftop bar, and Punch Room, a reservation-only lounge open until 2:00. Mr & Mrs Bund, on the sixth floor of 18 The Bund, serves lunch and dinner daily and asks you to phone for same-day tables.

In Jing'an, Café Gray Deluxe on the third floor of Upper House Shanghai serves breakfast from 6:30, weekend brunch and afternoon tea, and its lounge stays open until 1:00. Sui Tang Li, one floor down, describes itself as a contemporary Shanghai bistro and opens daily for lunch and dinner. URBAN Café at The Sukhothai Shanghai on Weihai Road also starts breakfast at 6:30. In Xintiandi, T'ang Court at The Langham lists two stars in the 2026 Michelin Guide, and Polux by Paul Pairet on Taicang Road opens daily from 11:00 to 22:00.
summaryCards: Start at Shanghai Museum (People's Square) with a ticket booked ahead, then head to the Bund for the Fairmont Peace Hotel's Jazz Bar.
Take breakfast from 6:30 at Café Gray Deluxe or URBAN Café, then walk to the Shanghai Natural History Museum in Jing'an Sculpture Park.
Check closing days: Monday for the People's Square museum, and Tuesday for Shanghai Museum East and the Shanghai Natural History Museum.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Many Shanghai operators publish mainly through WeChat or mini-programs, and a large number of official sites could not be read by automated fetch (connection refused, HTTP 403/405/418, certificate or SSL errors, or empty pages), including Yu Garden, the Oriental Pearl Tower, Shanghai Tower, the Long Museum, Power Station of Art, Lost Heaven, Seesaw Coffee and several luxury hotels; none of these failures is evidence of closure. No independent bakery or coffee roaster could be confirmed, so the bakery and coffee lists rely on hotel cafés. Hours were not published for the Shanghai Zoo, the Fairmont Peace Hotel's Jazz Bar, Cathay Room, Victor's Café and Peace Museum, or the Shanghai World Financial Center observatory. Rockbund Art Museum, the CPC memorial, the Shanghai Jewish Refugees Museum and Polux by Paul Pairet showed current hours but no dated 2026 content, and Cachet's weekday closing time is printed ambiguously as '00:00 am'.
